newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman's Sultan Qaboos orders salary increases.
newsitem.headline: Oman's Sultan Qaboos orders salary increases.

text.p: Oman's Sultan Qaboos bin Said on Wednesday ordered salary increases for low-ranking military personnel and public servants to mark the 27th anniversary of his ascending the throne.
A royal court statement said two categories of the armed forces would receive between five and eight percent pay increases from August 1.
Low-ranking civil servants would receive between 10 and 15 percent.
"About 38,000 civil servants will benefit from the Sultan's order," a source familiar with public sector staffing in Oman told Reuters.
"The starting monthly basic salaries of the public sector categories included by the Sultan's order range between 55 and 92 Omani rials ($143 and $240)," the source added.
Civil servants said it was the first time a wide-ranging pay increase had been granted since Qaboos came to power in 1970.
